components.name: Current menu
components.description: Concept C capsule glass bottom dock at every viewport, with 64px background blur, 1.8 saturation, 52% white glass, diagonal reflection, light-catching edges and crisp ink icons and five 14px labels, a 620px maximum width, safe-area inset, faint orange/navy edge shadows and solid-white fallback. Brand/data context stays in the topbar. English keeps Reserve / Returns with complete accessible names; preview is in normal flow.

components.name: Product card
components.description: Quiet Gallery gives photo and full product code equal recognition weight in one native button, with a decorative directional icon and useful no-photo state. Two columns through 600px, three from 601px within 1120px. Detail waits for explicit size selection; back restores search/focus.
components.css: .ds-icon{width:24px;height:24px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.5;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;flex-shrink:0}.ds-card{display:grid;align-content:start;gap:12px;min-width:0;width:220px;max-width:100%;background:var(--ds-paper);color:var(--ds-ink);border:0;border-radius:var(--ds-photo-radius);padding:0;text-align:left;font:600 18px/28px var(--ds-font);cursor:pointer}.ds-photo-empty{display:grid;align-content:center;place-items:center;gap:8px;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:var(--ds-photo-radius);background:var(--ds-surface);color:var(--ds-muted);font:400 14px/22px var(--ds-font);transition:box-shadow var(--ds-motion-selection) var(--ds-motion-ease),transform var(--ds-motion-selection) var(--ds-motion-ease)}.ds-photo-empty>.ds-icon{width:36px;height:36px}.ds-code{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:8px;min-width:0;padding-inline:2px}.ds-code>span{overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-code>.ds-icon{width:18px;height:18px;margin-top:5px;color:var(--ds-primary)}.ds-card:hover .ds-photo-empty{box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--ds-secondary-border)}.ds-card:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ds-primary);outline-offset:3px}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.ds-card:hover .ds-photo-empty{transform:translateY(-2px)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-photo-empty{transition:none}}

narrative.northStar: คนในร้านที่ช่วยงานได้
narrative.overview: Approved Fastwork foundations on white with Khonnai navy/orange. Existing mascot; Rammetto One wordmark with navy-to-orange gradient. Quiet Gallery balances photo and complete code recognition; one glass floating bottom dock serves desktop and mobile while Brand and data context remain in the topbar. Premium refinement preserves precise hierarchy, considered content widths, a dominant bill total and immediately visible operational content. Existing business flows and the dedicated receipt presentation remain independent; the public landing is a separate marketing surface.
keyCharacteristics: อ่านง่ายสำหรับเจ้าของร้าน40+ และใช้งานด้วยมือถือ
สีแบ่งหน้าที่ รูปทรงเรียบ ลดกรอบซ้อน
ไม่เปลี่ยนข้อมูลหรือขั้นตอนเดิมเพื่อให้เข้ากับภาพการตลาด
Quiet Gallery: photo and full code in one tile; two mobile columns, three from601px.
One five-destination glass dock at every width; labels stay at least14px and English words remain complete.

rules.name: The Action Role Rule
rules.body: สีต้องคู่กับชื่อปุ่มหรือสถานะ: กรมท่าบันทึก ส้มเพิ่ม เขียวพร้อมขาย แดงลบ/ยกเลิก เทากดไม่ได้ ห้ามใช้สีอย่างเดียวบอกความหมาย
